## Primary Pages & Documentation

- [Home](https://www.akshardeep.com/): Comprehensive overview of industrial valve automation solutions, instrumentation, key statistics, client logos, and partner brands.
- [About Us](https://www.akshardeep.com/about): Company history (2013–2025 milestones timeline), 5,420 sq. ft facility overview, 14+ years experience, and official channel partnerships with Forbes Marshall, Intervalve, and El-O-Matic.
- [Products Catalog](https://www.akshardeep.com/products): Complete range of over 150+ product lines.
  - [Butterfly Valves](https://www.akshardeep.com/products/butterfly-valves): Bonded & replaceable seat concentric, PTFE seated, and Triple Offset High Performance (IVTEX) butterfly valves for pressures up to Class #600 and sizes 40 NB to 1200 NB.
  - [Ball Valves](https://www.akshardeep.com/products/ball-valves): Trunnion mounted (2/3 piece), floating, 3-piece forged steel, jacketed, and tank bottom ball valves for Class #150 to #2500 and sizes 15 NB to 700 NB.
  - [Gate, Globe & Check Valves](https://www.akshardeep.com/products/gate-globe-check): Cast steel & forged steel gate, globe, dual plate check, and wafer type check valves per API 600 / API 602 / API 594 standards.
  - [Specialty Valves & Accessories](https://www.akshardeep.com/products/other-valves): PFA/FEP lined ball & butterfly valves, jacketed ball valves, 3-way ball valves, Y-type & basket strainers, full view and double window sight glasses.
  - [Valve Automation](https://www.akshardeep.com/products/valve-automation): El-O-Matic P-series & E-series single/double acting pneumatic actuators (4–4022 Nm torque), SIL 3 certified ON/OFF automation packages, positioners, and SCADA/DCS control panels.
  - [Diaphragm Seal Replacement](https://www.akshardeep.com/products/diaphragm-seal): Badotherm India JV partnership (Badotherm Holland Inc., est. 1957) — high-quality diaphragm seal replacement for any brand/type of pressure transmitter to save cost and cut downtime.
  - [Instrumentation](https://www.akshardeep.com/products/instrumentation): Precision pressure gauges (SP & GP), chemical seal gauges, RTD sensors (PT-100), thermocouples (J/K/N/R/S/B/T/E), bimetallic & gas filled temperature gauges, and level switches with NABL traceability.
  - [Pneumatics & Process Instruments](https://www.akshardeep.com/products/pneumatics): Electromagnetic, Coriolis, ultrasonic, and vortex flowmeters, control valves (1/2" to 16"), IBR safety relief valves, and Forbes Marshall steam traps.
- [Solutions & Capabilities](https://www.akshardeep.com/capabilities): Industrial valve automation, pressure & temperature measurement systems, flow monitoring, and custom engineered valve assembly packages.
- [Industries Served](https://www.akshardeep.com/industries): Chemical Plants, Pharmaceutical, Oil & Gas, Power Plants, Refineries, Steel Plants, Fertilizers, Water Treatment, and Manufacturing.
- [Services Division](https://www.akshardeep.com/services): Complete valve repair, NABL-traceable positioner calibration, API 598 hydrostatic body/seat testing, actuator & positioner mounting, diaphragm seal replacement, and emergency field support.
- [Contact Us](https://www.akshardeep.com/contact): Direct sales inquiry form, phone contacts (+91 94294 83636 / +91 99798 99983), email (sales@akshardeep.com), and facility location in Ankleshwar GIDC.

## Channel Partners & Brands
- **Forbes Marshall**: Forbes Marshall (HVY) Pvt. Ltd. — Steam traps, control valves, flowmeters, and process efficiency solutions.
- **Intervalve**: Intervalve Poonamwala Pvt. Ltd. — Concentric & High Performance butterfly valves, gate, globe, check, and ball valves.
- **El-O-Matic**: El-O-Matic India Pvt. Ltd. — Rack & pinion pneumatic actuators (P-Series & E-Series) and valve automation accessories.
- **Badotherm**: Badotherm India (JV with Badotherm Holland Inc., Est. 1957) — Diaphragm seals, chemical seal pressure gauges, and transmitter seal replacement.
- **Additional Brands Supplied**: Badotherm, Yokogawa, ABB, Emerson, Rotork, Endress+Hauser, Siemens, Honeywell.
